objective: Find source-grounded mechanisms for adaptive per-cell compute allocation under a hard deterministic budget, with explicit stopping and without granting model/reward signals canonical state, effect or completion authority.

source_observations: UCB1 maintains per-arm count, sum, mean and expectation and scores a trained arm as mean + alpha * sqrt((2 * log(total_count)) / arm_count).
Prediction selects argmax expectation; the utility explicitly returns the first key with the maximum value, so a canonical arm ordering can make score ties deterministic.
The library exposes simulation and multiple contextual/non-contextual policies; importing the full library would be substantially broader than the WP505 primitive requires.
sources.f2_hypothesis: A very thin deterministic UCB-style exploration bonus can allocate bounded extra compute among GRID cells using only admitted historical evaluation signals while preserving a hard total budget.
counterhypotheses: Bandit reward proxies can Goodhart the allocator and create self-reinforcing starvation of rarely selected cells.
Nonstationary cognitive workloads violate simple stationary-bandit assumptions.
A full MABWiser dependency is unnecessary; the useful mechanism may be a tiny auditable equation plus deterministic tie-break and decay/reset policy.

sources.source: Raposo et al., Mixture-of-Depths: Dynamically allocating compute in transformer-based language models, arXiv:2404.02258
source_observations: The method fixes a total layer compute capacity k in advance while dynamically choosing which tokens consume that capacity via top-k routing.
Total compute is predictable while allocation is context-sensitive.
sources.f2_hypothesis: WP505 should separate a deterministic hard compute envelope from adaptive allocation inside that envelope: dynamic distribution must never be allowed to expand the total budget.
counterhypotheses: MoD routing is learned and model-internal; copying its router would blur the deterministic control-plane boundary.
Token-level routing economics may not transfer to heterogeneous GRID cell workloads.

sources.source: Banino, Balaguer, Blundell, PonderNet: Learning to Ponder, arXiv:2107.05407
source_observations: PonderNet adapts the number of computation steps to problem complexity and explicitly trades predictive objective against computational cost.
sources.f2_hypothesis: WP505 needs an explicit marginal-value-versus-cost stop rule so extra cell compute terminates when expected information gain no longer justifies budget use.
counterhypotheses: A learned halting policy is not suitable as deterministic F2 authority.
The useful transfer may be only the stop-cost decomposition, not the training algorithm.

cross_source_fusion.proposed_noncanonical_score_shape_for_fu: priority(cell) = admitted_task_value + uncertainty_bonus + bounded_exploration_bonus - measured_cost_penalty - starvation_guard_penalty_or_floor
mandatory_fences: The hard cycle/token/time/resource envelope is deterministic authority and cannot be enlarged by a model or bandit score.
Scores are scheduling candidates, not facts, goals, completion or effect authority.
Tie-breaking must be canonical and replay-stable.
Reward/evaluation inputs require typed provenance and generation binding; self-reported model success is insufficient.
Unknown evaluation remains UNKNOWN; missing reward must not silently become zero/negative truth.
A starvation floor or scheduled exploration test is required before any adoption because pure exploitation can suppress under-observed cells.
Any adaptive state must be rebuildable from canonical admitted history or otherwise remain explicitly noncanonical controller state.
cross_source_fusion.why_not_build_yet: E1 establishes source relevance only. No current-F2 architecture mapping, baseline, ablation, latency/resource measurement or fail-closed implementation test has been performed.

next_recommended_objective.goal: Map the thin UCB/hard-cap/stop pattern onto current WP500/501/505 interfaces, identify the exact admitted signals and canonical budget owner, and design deterministic replay/starvation/nonstationarity falsifiers before any code import or build handoff.
